item.text: The exporter stops when a page contains fewer records than requested, but deleted records can shorten a page even when more pages remain. Projects use a larger page size, which masks this in the reported example. I reproduced the failure and will make pagination stop only when the gateway returns a null cursor.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Pagination now follows the gateway cursor until it returns `null`, including short or empty pages caused by deleted records.

The reported case now exports both `i-1` and `i-3`. Added regression coverage for that case and empty bookmarks/pages.

All 4 tests pass with `node --experimental-strip-types --test`; diff checks pass.
